item.title: FitTrack Ad From Supplied Screenshots

turns.text: Make a 10-second widescreen 16:9 ad for FitTrack using both screenshots. Show the home screen first, then the workout screen, and finish with the app name. Clean, energetic, with an upbeat instrumental beat and no voiceover. Other copy is your call.

item.tests: Uses supplied app screenshots faithfully in a finished landscape ad rather than inventing replacement screens.

answer_sheet.Brand and source images: FitTrack; use app-home.png followed by app-workout.png.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Clean and energetic; other design choices are your call.
answer_sheet.On-screen wording: End with FitTrack; other copy is your call, in English.

must_haves: The final video is 10 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
The supplied FitTrack home screenshot appears before the supplied workout screenshot.
Both screenshots remain recognizable and readable, without invented replacement UI.
An upbeat instrumental track is audible, with no voiceover.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a polished 10-second 16:9 widescreen motion-graphics advertisement for the fitness app FitTrack using BOTH supplied screenshots, in this exact order. Treat @home and @workout as actual app UI artwork, preserve their text, layout, blue and green colors and proportions; do not invent alternate app screens. Clean white background, crisp dark typography, electric blue and fresh green graphic accents, energetic but uncluttered. Timeline: 0.0–3.5 seconds show @home first, fully visible and legible as a portrait screenshot centered in a sleek phone-shaped frame on the right, with short large headline on left 'Your day. In motion.' Gentle push-in, blue accent shapes. 3.5–7.5 seconds transition with a fast smooth horizontal slide to @workout, fully visible and legible in the same phone frame; headline 'Make every rep count.' Green accents, restrained rhythmic motion. 7.5–10.0 seconds transition away from the screenshot to a clean centered final brand card with exact large text 'FitTrack' and smaller text 'Track your day. Own your progress.' Hold the brand name clearly through the final frame. Keep all content inside widescreen safe margins. No people, no voiceover, no spoken words, no vocals, no subtitles. AUDIO: continuous upbeat energetic instrumental electronic fitness beat, punchy drums, bright synths and warm bass, approximately 124 BPM; transitions synchronized to the beat, clean musical ending at 10 seconds. Premium crisp flat motion design, smooth easing, no frantic camera motion.
